summary: Essential Utilities filed an 8-K disclosing a joint petition for non-unanimous settlement filed September 15, 2026, in the Pennsylvania Public Utility Commission proceeding regarding its pending merger with American Water Works. The deal, announced October 26, 2025, calls for Merger Sub to merge into Essential Utilities, which would survive as a wholly owned American Water subsidiary. The settlement, joined by the Bureau of Investigation and Enforcement, Office of Consumer Advocate, Office of Small Business Advocate and others, but not all parties, now goes to Administrative Law Judges for a Recommended Decision before PaPUC review and approval. Terms were not restated; no closing date, price, or premium disclosed in this excerpt. Watch the unsettled parties and regulatory clock, as their positions could shape conditions or timing.
